nom: Philosophy Purity Made Simple Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser

avis.texte: I really enjoyed using the pure purifying foam cleanser. I have very oily skin so it really helps ￼ my skin feel nice and clean. I love the foam dispenser. The texture of foam feels nice it does it feel rough and gritty like other cleansers it's my preference. The price isn't bad for the quality of the product

Really like this cleanser! It leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh without drying it out. The foamy texture is gentle, and my skin feels smooth and balanced after every wash. Great for everyday use!

avis.titre: A skincare product that actually visibly works and does w...
avis.texte: This is my favorite cleanser I have tried in awhile! I wasn't sure if this one would work well with my skin but my skin LOVES it! I am a 40 year old woman, so my skin is sensitive and very dry, with some texture and redness. This cleanser not only feels so wonderful to use, but it visibly works!! I can actually see that my pores are improving after using it regularly! I feel like with skincare oftentimes it's so hard to see a difference, but I definitely see an improvement with this one! The foam is lovely! The pump gives you the perfect amount, and the foam is fluffy and lightweight, it feels light and airy on the skin and lathers up nicely! And after using it my skin feels so soft, not tight or dry at all! The scent is light, clean and fresh. I will absolutely be repurchasing this one when it's gone, it's a 10/10 for me! I'm IMPRESSED!

This cleanser is light and has a fresh, clean, light fragrance that is somewhat herbal. The dispenser gives just the right amount of foam. That foam easily washes away makeup and excess oil, but isn't over-drying. It left me feeling clean and ready for fresh skin care.

I'm absolutely in love with this purity made simple pore purifying foam cleanser! It lathers super well and makes my skin feel so clean and soft after using it. I feel like it's priced just right and I plan to repurchase in the future!

Philosophy is such a well known brand for so many amazing products ranging from skincare to body care, even perfumes so I knew I would love their Purity Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser! This foam cleanser is wonderful! I love how clean and fresh I feel after washing my face and I enjoy that my skin doesn't have that dry or tight feeling at all but instead smooth, hydrated and glowy! I like how this is great for sensitive skin and didn't cause any irritation at all but helped remove excess oil and almost help reduce incoming breakouts! I'm also loving the scent this foam cleanser has I almost feel like I'm at the spa while using it! This is such a great foam cleanser and perfect for everyday use! Definitely becoming a go to for my skincare routine!
Love this gentle cleanser. My skin feels clean and fresh after I wash my face. It doesn't dry my skin out. The foaming pump is great to get that nice consistency when washing your face.
This foaming cleanser has exceeded my expectations. It literally purifies skin, melts away all the dirt and does not leave my skin dry or irritated. Very gentle on the skin. Absolutely love it.
This is a very very lightweight foaming face wash that has papaya enzymes and is gentle in the skin. It's very lightweight so it didn't clog the pores.
I love a good foaming cleanser. This one from Philosophy does a great job at cleansing without stripping my skin. It rinses clean without leaving any residue.

love how convenient this pump is because it instantly delivers a thick, fluffy cloud of foam that spreads easily and washes off cleanly without leaving any weird residue behind. It has been a total game-changer for keeping my combination skin balanced; it clears out oil and prevents my pores from looking congested, yet it leaves my face feeling incredibly soft and smooth rather than tight or stripped. The mild exfoliation from the glycolic acid and enzymes gives my skin a really healthy, natural brightness over time without causing any irritation. It works beautifully as a refreshing morning wash or as a second-step cleanser to ensure everything is completely fresh and clean. If you want a straightforward, effective foam that leaves your skin feeling genuinely purified and comfortable, this one is an excellent addition to your routine.
I've been using this cleanser for the past few weeks and it feels like it really cleans my pores. I only use it like 2-3 times a week for my in depth cleanse and I really enjoy it!

I have been using Philosophy Purity pore purifying foam cleanse with papaya enzyme & glycolic acid, and it's a great foaming cleanser. I've used it morning and night for several weeks and have noticed a change in my skin. I apply 3 pumps of the foam to damp skin and it rinses off easily. It does not leave any residue .My skin feels very soft and hydrated, and my pores are less visible.

I'm very picky on face washes because I have really sensitive combination skin which means there are oily parts and dry parts and prone to acne. I can honestly say that this face wash was just right and I like using it as my nightly wash. It makes your face feel clean but not stripped and dry which is what I look for. Me and my bf also noticed it really does clean up the pores and makes them smaller and you can notice that even after the first wash, he even came to me to show me that on his own randomly so it's not just me in my head 😅 So yeah 10/10 would recommend 👌

I received the philosophy pore purifying foam cleanser from Influenster for my honest opinion and I really love how it doesn't dry my skin out like most cleansers do there's no sticky residue left behind I believe so far that it very effective and the consistency has stayed the same it's almost like any foam cleanser or soap for that matter but I have enjoyed adding this to my skin care routine and I do believe it is now a staple in my routine
I like this cleanser, because it's helps to my Skin .. the application is so easy, the value good AND the durability Is Good to but it's depends on the weather of your country. The packaging Is Good.
I like how it's super foamy with very fine bubbles. Easy to use, very little/no scent. Definitely a nice every day cleanser I'll continue to use!

My face is thanking me for introducing this Philosophy Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser to my skincare routine. Not only is it easy to use because it pumps out of the bottle as foam, it leaves my skin squeaky clean and I have noticed less break outs since incorporating this product. The formula is gentle and I have noticed less break experienced any irritation so this is good for sensitive skin. A win/win to find an effective product to cleanse my skin but also reduces acne, that's a two in one.

Philosophy's Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser left my skin feeling great! The foam is gentle on my skin and cleansed my skin so well. It did not dry out my skin and I could see a difference with my pores.

avis.titre: Leave my skin clean, fresh, and balanced without drying o...
avis.texte: I really enjoyed this cleanser. It creates a soft foam that leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed without feeling stripped or overly dry. The formula rinses easily and helps remove excess oil while still keeping my skin comfortable and hydrated. Great option for anyone looking for a gentle daily cleanser.

I love this face wash! I like to let it sit for about a minute to let the glycolic acid exfoliate and it works great! It has an invigorating smell and has a nice foam. Definitely noticed a positive difference in skin texture!
Purity pore purifying cleanser by Philosophy is a great cleanser that gently exfoliates and deep cleanse the skin. It feels gentle on the skin and does not strip away the moisture.

I have really been enjoying adding this cleanser to my routine. It leaves my skin feeling clean without that tight, stripped feeling. It rinses away easily and removes the buildup from the day. It's a great everyday cleanser and even my daughter likes to play seeing the foam coming out of the dispenser.

Wow do I love this cleanser. One, the bottle is huge so you are getting a ton of bang for your buck. The foaming aspect makes me feel very clean and that it is actually working and doing its job. No irritation or scent

It was my first time using a philosophy cleanser and let me tell you, I'm sold! It didn't leave my face feeling tight or dry and the consistency was smooth and light . My pores weren't as noticeable as my skin felt less texturized but not dry and tight if that makes since. I didn't need a large amount as one pump worked for me. I would definitely buy this product again.

I love this cleanser as it really deeply cleans without stripping skin of its natural oils. What I like is it does the job and it's very light on the skin unlike heavy gel cleansers. A little bit lathers up well and goes a long way!
Really gentle and effective. It leaves my skin feeling really clean without drying it out , and the foam is so soft and easy to rinse off. I've noticed my skin feels fresher after every use.
I've been loving the philosophy purity made simple foam cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling clean, soft and refreshed without drying it out. The lightweight foam is perfect for everyday use 💚

This is a really good foaming cleanser. It does really well, removing any kind of residue from makeup and oil cleanser. It has a nice smell and foams up well also. It makes my face feel really clean without drying out my skin..
I have really been enjoying the Philosophy Pore Purifying foam cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling so cleans, soft, and fresh. I love the light clean scent! This is definitely a new favorite
I really like this cleaner! It foams really nice and it feels great on my skin. One pump is all you need. My skin feels moisturized after I use it. It does not feel dry and scaly.

avis.titre: Worth the buy if you have sensitive skin.
avis.texte: This is a really nice cleanser. The pump produces a nice lathery foam. Even with how gentle this is on my skin, it still works well to remove my makeup.
I love this stuff!! I was so exited to try it! It is nice and soft in skin, no residue left over. And I love the look of the bottle!! Helped with mild breakouts too!

I am giving this a 5 star only because my husband loved it. I have Rosacea and it flared my skin up. However, my husband who does not have sensitive skin, it worked out great for him. He also has oily skin. He told me that his face felt so clean and not dry at all. He even noticed that it wasnt getting that oily anymore. Loves that it is a foam cleanser too. FYI he is a blue collar worker so he be outside all day and he felt nice and fresh after using this.

If you're looking for something light, mild fragrance and moisturizing, this is the one! And not only helped clean my skin, but I also didn't leave it dry like some face wash do it's perfect for the summertime where you just want to lightly refresh without stripping any of your skin barrier!
Over all this was a pretty good face cleanser. I'll liked the foam because I don't like putting heavy products on my face. I didn't really notice the pores getting smaller but my face felt clean
The Philosophy purifying foam cleanser works great! It leaves my face feeling nice and soft and not greasy. I use it in the am and pm which has helped my face stay clean and blemish free.

I have been using the Philosophy Pore Purifying Foam Cleansert for about a month now and I really like it. It seems to do a great job of removing the dirt and makeup from my face, but it doesn't seem to completely strip my skin. 1 pump is plenty for my entire face and I still have most of a bottle, even after the month of usage. I haven't noticed an extreme difference in my skin, but my skin is pretty clear most of the time. The smell is light and it seems to clean pretty gently. I've really liked it!
I like the texture, nice smell, my skin feels amazing, good for sensitive skin, I think the product is going to last because I only have to use an small amount.

avis.titre: One of my favorite facial cleansers
avis.texte: This has been one of my favorite foam facial cleansers! The smell is so good and the foam has been easy to rinse off. My face has been SO much clearer and has felt so clean and smooth. Will definitely purchase this product again!
I love this pore purifying cleanser it works so good by week two I noticed my pores appeared smaller and clear I would recommend this for those with congested pores

I wear a ton of mascara and black eyeliner so I like a good one and done makeup remover that doesn't dry me out. This is one of the more amazing foam cleaners, I can rub and rub the foam in my hands but its stays the texture of whip cream! Not dry8ng, good around eyes and no smell. One pump is enough so product lasts more than 1mo th for sure, have half the bottle left! I really like this brand, have a day cream and shower cream as well!

Love this. Very light scent. My skin feels so lovely after using this cleanser. It works to take off my makeup as well. Feels like my pores are getting smaller time will tell as I continue to use this

Philosophy Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser leaves my face feeling clean, soft and refreshed without drying it out. The foam is light weight, removes dirt and makeup easily, and has light pleasant scent. A little goes a long way, making it a great everyday cleanser.

avis.titre: Amazing product for textured skin with large pores
avis.texte: The Philosophy Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser is truly a one stop product to cover all your face cleansing needs. It has a spa like sent and is very gentle on your skin. I tend to double cleanse my skin however I noticed that after one use my skin felt so soft and very clean. I have oily skin and there's zero residue. I'm really impressed at how a little product goes a very long way. Excellent skincare product for textured skin girlies looking to have clean skin.

This is my favorite pore purifying foam cleanser. I noticed less pimples and blackheads. My skin feels clean and conditioned. It cleans without stripping the skin. Soft foam texture. Light scent. Formulated with papaya enzyme and glycolic acid. Great product! Thank you Influenster and Philosophy for my complimentary pore purifying foam cleanser.

Philosophy's Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser works like a charm for me! It's highly effective at cleansing my pores and keeping my skin looking great. Ever since I started using it I haven't noticed any blackheads either. I appreciate that I can use this and it doesn't leave my skin feeling dry afterwards. It foams nicely and is definitely worth trying!
Love this concept of the foam. Its light and airy but still helps my skin feel clean and fresh. It has a light scent. The packaging is sleek and easy to store.

avis.titre: Shrunk the blackheads around my nose!
avis.texte: I've bought philosophy products before but this one was given to me for free in exchange for a honest review. It is a foam cleanser for purifying pores. I was happy to try this out since I've struggled with blackheads for a long time and recently started getting larger pores all over my face. I used the foam cleanser every morning and every night then followed with a moisturizer. I find the product super easy to use. I apply one pump to my hands and massage onto my wet face. The scent is exactly like the gel cleanser I have from philosophy years ago. It's an herbal scent. It washed off easily and left my face feeling nice. Without moisturizing, it might leave your face a little tight but not too drying. I have noted my pores/blackheads are smaller! But it's been almost a month of using this and they aren't completely cleared out. I am going to try to combine it with a benzoyl peroxide cream at night and see if that will speed up the process. Overall, I'm very happy with the ingredients, quick/easy use, packaging, and smaller blackhead result! I included a photo of what my pores look like right now.
This is such an amazing facial wash! It smells like a clean lemongrass scent with a foaming luxury feel. It's hydrating and smooth. I can't say enough about this cleanser, it's absolutely incredible!

avis.titre: Nice cleanser- just make sure it's for your skin type!
avis.texte: This is a nice cleanser especially for the price ($29). It's a decent size (5 oz), and you don't need much product (maybe half a pump) for your whole face. I like the fact that it's a foam. Some other cleansers require you to add water to get it to foam, and they don't always lather well. No problem here! The cleanser has great ingredients for pore cleansing like glycolic acid and papaya enzyme. However, it's just too strong for my sensitive combo skin. My face feels tight and reactive after using although it definitely feels clean! If you have oily skin and don't react to ingredients, you'll love this. It gets the job done! Even though this product isn't a good fit for my specific skin type, this left a good impression on me, and I'm going to check out other products by this brand.

Finally found a cleanser that doesn't dry out my skin. The texture is super soft and fully, and it goes on so softly and gentle on the skin and yet it has the papaya enzymes still gently exfoliate, but it doesn't feel like I'm exfoliating at all. I am obsessed with the smell it smells so good. It just makes me wanna like keep cleaning my face over and over again just for that smell, and it doesn't strip my skin which I really like it makes me feel moisturized and not so dry afterwards . this is a great addition to my routine that I will keep up with. ￼￼
I received this product free from Influenster and Philosophy for my honest opinion. It feels like and airy. The scent is pleasant. My skin feels fresh and renewed. I would recommend this product.
I like the packaging and the pump. I like foaming products and this goes well in my travel bag. No irritation m, no redness. I love it. I like how my skin is after

avis.titre: Great product and easy to use
avis.texte: I was given this product for free to try and give my honest opinion. I love this product and will be buying more of it. It smells amazing, foams up great, a little goes a long way. It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. It rinses off easy and is easy to use. I highly recommend this product for everyday use. I especially liked using it in the morning because I felt awake and refreshed after!

I really enjoyed this Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser from philosophy. It is gentle on my sensitive skin and did not cause any new breakouts. It lathers well and is easy to rinse off. The packaging is durable and I like the foam pump. The ingredients are also great.

avis.titre: Fresh, Clean Skin with Refined Pores
avis.texte: The Philosophy Pore Purifying Cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean, fresh, and smooth without feeling stripped. It helps reduce excessive oil and makes my pores look less noticeable after regular use.

avis.titre: Gentle foam that leaves skin clean and refreshed🫧✨
avis.texte: The rich foam applies easily, cleans effectively, feels gentle on skin, offers a generous amount of product, and leaves skin refreshed after every use✨

I love philosophy and their purity line is such a classic that the scent of this brought me back to my younger years. That being said, I don't know if this is for every type of skin. I have a bit more sensitive skin that's prone to barrier issues. This face wash definitely cleans your skin well but it reminds me of a bar of soap kind of clean. Some people love that, but it doesn't work for my skin because it leaves it feeling a bit stripped. I do love that it's a foam and you get a generous amount. Overall it still seems like a great product if you skin can handle it well.

I used this cleanser nightly to remove makeup and refresh after a workout. The pump gives out a tad more product than I need, but was easy to use. The foam is expansive and spreads into a thick texture, ideal for removing the fat's grime. Although my skin isn't sensitive to fragrance, my nose is. But I found this botanical scent calming and lux, like a spa/salon experience. It was a great way to end the day.

I generally prefer a gel-to-foam cleanser but this was a nice addition for second wash after oil cleansing. Sometimes, I like to press it in first and feel it bubble along my pores before fully washing, it feels nice! Super soft on the skin and it doesn't strip moisture or leave my skin feeling overly dry. It very gently helps to shed away dead skin and I have seen some improvement in minimizing pores. It has a scent but it's mild and smells nice and spa-like!

I love putting this on my face haha the form tickles it but I feel thats what makes it it works!! My pores looks pretty good and i feel its cleaning it out. It doesnt leave a weird film on my face and the scent isn't too strong. I will continue to use it and might buy a new bottle!!

As someone who LOVES Philosophy products for the body and face, I was so excited to try out this pore cleanser, which automatically converts into a light, airy foam when pumping out of the bottle. It's pretty good at removing grime and makeup, but I actually like using it as a cleanser for my lash extensions. I've been using it for over a week with no breakouts, although I would definitely recommend moisturizing since it does leave your skin a bit on the drier side.

I love this product! I've been using Philosophy body wash, face products and perfumes for years. But this one has been my favorite so far. It doesn't have much of a lather, but that doesn't stop it from leaving my skin silky smooth and much brighter. I've also noticed a more even skin tone. Will definitely continue to use.

avis.titre: Light citrusie foam not doing much
avis.texte: It's nice and light, great for the summer. Has a very light scent to it, citrusie herbal. I like that it rates high on Yuka, which means the ingredients are better than some of the other ones. I do feel though that I need to double cleanse when I use this cleanser, it doesn't clean everything. It melts on your skin too quickly to be able to clean it properly. I don't think it does anything cleaning the pores. It's too easy to wash off and it left my skin a bit dry feeling.

I really like this foam cleanser from Philosophy. It is a bit more watery than most foam cleansers but suds up and spreads easily. It's gentle on my skin and hasn't caused any irritation or dryness. It doesn't cause my skin to feel stripped after using either. Overall, it's a very nice cleanser and I enjoyed using it.

avis.titre: Papaya enzyme cleanser that checks all the boxes!!
avis.texte: I am always so hesitant to try new face washes because my skin breaks out 2 days after switching without fail but I am pleased to report that was not the case with this!!! The foaming formula leaves my face feeling clean but not dried out and rinses off so much easier than any gel formulas I've tried. I also love the ingredients i haven't tried any other products with Papaya before this! I am so happy with Philosphy and will be trying out other products ASAP.
Foams pretty nicely, I was expecting more though. Leaves my face feeling clean and doesn't cause any reactions. Doesn't have an overpowering scent.
Light scent,easy dispensing with a smooth foam. Soft application that spreads easily on the skin. Good comfort after use. Helps with breakouts but may feel a bit drying for sensitive skin.

I like this product as it clean my face effectively and not overly dry on my skin. The soft foamy texture easy to use and easily wash off as well. It has light scent that I'm not a big fans of but I can live with it as it works well on my skin.

I received this product free in exchange for my honest opinion. I really enjoyed this cleanser. The papaya gives it a nice fruity scent. It worked well to cleanse while also hydrating my face. Even after a long day at work, my face didn't feel oily like it usually does. I don't think it helped to make my pores feel minimized and I still experienced my usual acne but it works as a nice face wash if you're looking for soft skin. I'm not a fan of foaming face washes so it's not something I'd likely buy but I'd be interested in a gel cleanser.

avis.titre: A great cleanser for everyday use
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using Philosophy Purity Made Simple Foaming Cleanser. It leaves my skin clean, fresh and soft without drying it out. The foam is light and gentle, and it removes dirt and makeup easily. A great cleanser for everyday use.

I absolutely love this product. I have used it for a few weeks now, and it makes my skin feel so smooth, and so easy to lather and apply is amazing! It doesn't leave any weird residue, makes my skin feel more firm, and it makes it dewey! 🫶🫶🫶
This wash is absolutely amazing!! I am addicted and will be purchasing more! One pump is all it takes and my skin feels so clean! I definitely see a difference in my pores and skin texture also

I was so pleasant surprised by this cleanser. I have dry skin so generally a foam cleanser leaves my skin feeling dry. This did not. It felt hydrated after use. Two cleanses with this took my makeup off. It felt really gentle which I appreciate. And the packaging is cute. If you are in the market for a new gentle foaming cleanser give this a try.

I use this weekly and I can genuinely say it helps clean pores WELL. I usually use an oil based cleanser, and between that, the hot weather making me sweat, and makeup, I usually need a refresh and this does that perfectly.

This cleanser has fast become one of my favorites. The foam is thick and generous and is so easy to use. It rinses easily and doesn't leave any residue. It effectively cleans my skin and leaves it feeling refreshed. I love the addition of papaya and glycolic acid because they leave my skin glowing. At the same time, it doesn't irritate it or leave it tight and dry. A must have in my skincare routine.

This was a foamy cleanser , there was no scent to it. But unfortunately it did break me out might be too strong for sensitive skin. The other product itself was easy to use . The packaging was nice as well just wish it hadn't broken me out . On the other hand my face felt clean after I used it . So I think it's worth trying it if u don't have super sensitive skin.

I really liked this cleanser strictly for my pores. I have large pores so at the end of the day this really felt refreshing. My face felt lighter and my skin did not feel tight. My pores appeared smaller after using it consistently. PSA though, this does not remove makeup well, so use something to melt the makeup, and use this to truly cleanse your pores!

This gentle cleanser is the perfect first step for your beauty routine. It is mildly scented and perfect for sensitive skin. The foam also helps distribute the soap even better. I like that I can tell how much is left in the bottle.

Formulated with papaya enzymes and glycolic acid, making it perfect for gentle exfoliation and breaking down dead skin cells. The foam is lightweight, airy that feels refreshing on your skin without feeling heavy like some other foam washes. Effective for pore purification and help improve overall skin texture, leaving your skin looking brighter. I have combo skin and did pretty well. If your skin is sensitive I recommend introducing it slowly due to the active exfoliation acids. The foam did leave my face a tad sticky but that could be a user error and I didn't properly rinse off the foam cleanser.

avis.titre: Not my favorite cleanser but gets the job done
avis.texte: As a try and true original philosophy cleanser lover, I was so excited to try out their foam cleanser. I've never tried a foam cleanser before, so this was different for me. I used two pumps and that was to many pumps of cleanser at once. Applying it to the skin felt kind of dry. I also felt like I needed to definitely do a double cleanse to remove all of my makeup. It worked just not as well as there normal cleanser. I probably won't purchase this product.

Perfect for a deep clean! This cleanser is FANTASTIC for my pores! It is so foamy and cleans my skin so well. My acne has improved a lot since I started using it. The pump is an awesome feature to this product
I recommend it 100% I thought it would leave the skin dry but on the contrary it leaves my skin hydrated the application is super easy The skin doesn't feel tight

I have used philosophy's Purity Made Simple cream cleanser for decades. When I was offered to try this for free, I was in! I feel like you have to use a lot to get a good foam. It also is a little messy to rub on your face, and can get in your eyes easily. However, it did wash my face well and I had minimal residue left when using a toner afterward (what showed up on the cotton pad). Easy to use every day.

I tried the philosophy pore purifying foam cleanser for a while now. I love that it's super gentle on my skin. The foam is fine and fluffy, it gets into my pores and cleans them out. It keeps my skin hydrated and not dry like other harsh cleansers. It's perfect for sensitive skin that still needs a good cleaning. It smells amazing and does not leave a residue. It's good value for the money, one or two pumps is enough to wash your face with foam left over.

Reveal your freshest, Cleanest skin with Philosophy Pore purifying foan Cleanser. This lightweight foaming formula gently removers dirt, oil, and impurities while helping minimize the appearance of pores. Enjoy a deep yet refreshing cleanse that leaves skin feeling Soft, balanced and beautiful renewed every day.

avis.titre: A family favorite! Amazing for mature skin and my son's a...
avis.texte: As a longtime fan of Philosophy's original creamy Purity cleanser, I was thrilled to test out this new Pore Purifying Foam. I have dry, sensitive, maturing, and menopausal skin, so I am usually very careful with foaming cleansers. I used this a few times a week to get the exfoliating benefits of the glycolic acid. To my surprise, it didn't leave my skin feeling tight or stripped! The foam is incredibly thick, lathers beautifully, and a little goes a long way. It left my skin feeling completely cleaned with absolutely zero irritation. While I still prefer the original creamy emulsion for my dry skin type, this foam found a permanent home with my son. He has larger pores, blackheads, and textured skin. Since he started using it, his skin has improved significantly. His blackheads and breakouts are visibly reduced, and it doesn't dry him out. We both love that the scent is very minimal and quickly dissipates after rinsing. I will definitely continue buying this for him!

avis.titre: Light fragrance with a gentle cleansing
avis.texte: Love everything about this gentle face cleanser. The foam pump is super easy to use and the product has just a slight clean fragrance that disappears once washed away. It has been fun to try a new cleanser and really helps keep my skin soft and clean.

avis.titre: My skin has never looked better
avis.texte: This foaming cleanser is actually very good. It's super effective. It's really hard for me to find a cleanser that doesn't cause my skin to break out so far I've only been successful with the pink grapefruit Neutrogena, but this is on a complete other level. My skin has never been more clear, even toned, skin tighter, or pores smaller. It feels luxurious and airy and smell. Smells like a spa day. Such a good cleanser I'm very happy with it. I have combination oily skin with some dry patches on my chin, and they have gotten worse using my other cleanser when I made the switch to this within three days the red marks on either side of my chin all but disappeared. This will be my new cleanser now. ￼
I really enjoyed this cleanser.the foam is gentle, cleans deeply without drying out my skin, and leaves my face feeling fresh and purified after every use.

avis.titre: I love this product; it deeply cleanses the skin, leaving...
avis.texte: It is a vegan, foaming partial cleanser designed to deeply cleanse pores and visibly reduce their appearance without drying out the skin. It is a light foam that easily becomes opaque Thank you Its pump bottle is characterized by having a fresh, soft and clean artistic scent; This does not leave a greasy or sticky residue on the ski.

avis.titre: Love this gently exfoliating, pore clearing cleanser!
avis.texte: I have used Philosophy cleansers for years and have always been a huge fan, but I had always used the Purity One Step Facial Cleanser, so when I hit offered the Purity Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser I jumped at the chance! The first thing I noticed when using this cleanser was the consistency. This being a foam was a lot different for me, but I really enjoyed it. I also immediately noticed a slight exfoliating feeling with this cleanser that I didn't really notice with the other, and found that this was due to the papaya enzyme, which I LOVED! I'm very happy with this cleanser and definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a cleanser that will gently exfoliate as well as unclog pores.

I'm absolutely in love with the scent of this cleanser. It has a very comforting, herbal aroma derived from natural essential oil. The self foaming pump texture is incredibly convenient, just one pump gives a rich foam, so I just need to massage it on and rinse. I have very sensitive oily skin, so I am very picky with cleansers, but this Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser formula works wonders. If effectively controls excess sebum without drying me out, leaving my face felling deep clean, smooth, and fresh. Most importantly, it causes absolutely zero irritation or redness. It rinses off completely clean with zero sticky or greasy residue left behind, my skin look healthier. Highly recommended!

I have been a fan of Philosophy for years. Their Purity Made Simple pore purifying foam cleanser did not disappoint. The nozzle works great, dispensing the perfect amount with just one pump. The glycolic acid and papaya enzymes are hero ingredients. My face felt fresh, clean and not at all stripped. I also really liked that it is not heavily fragranced. It is truly simple and it works.

The consistency of this is like a thick foam. You can tell there are natural ingredients in it because you feel that almost dry feeling on the skin without the harsh stripping- like what your fingers feel like after peeling oranges. I do like that it does not break out the skin and the scent is not overpowering. It's a great cleanser that leaves the skin refreshed and supple.

avis.titre: A nice refresher for your face
avis.texte: After using philosophy for a full week 2 times a day I like that it never irritated my skin. Left my face feeling soft and looking clean. The soap seems to really absorb all the sweat and grease leaving my face ready and set for bed or makeup time

I received the philosophy Pore Purifying Foam Cleaner for Free in exchange for my honest opinion. I have been using this pore foam cleanser for about two weeks now. I actually really like it! Just the right amount comes out with each pump and you only need one or two pumps for each use. The foam is very lightweight and easily washes into your skin. There is not really any scent but it does leave your face feeling refreshed and clean. I highly recommend the philosophy Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser.

This product was just a "meh" for me. It has a nice scent and it is nice and foamy, but I didn't notice anything different than my drugstore brand. I feel like I can get a better product for half the price.
Loving the scent and how cleansing it is on my skin! Pure ingredients and helps prevent breakouts! The foam is my favorite part. I really enjoy Philosophy products!

My skin is rather sensitive, so I have to be careful about what products I use on it. Philosophy has been good to me in the past, so I gave this one a go. It is a foam, but this is a thick and luxurious foam. It's smooth in it skin and washes off in seconds. The scent is light and slightly herbal. It didn't irritate my skin or break it out in acne. It's a convenient formula and a good product. I like it a lot.

avis.titre: Will be using this every morning!
avis.texte: I use this product when I woke up this morning and it worked great for my skin. It felt very refreshing when I put it on and smelled like lemons. After rinsing it all off I felt amazing.
philosophy pore purifing foam Cleanser makes my face feel squeaky clean. I like that feeling a lot. No annoying scent, ingredients looks good.

The foam pump works great and it's a gentle cleanser overall, a great amount of product. When I used it I immediately broke out, but I have acne prone skin. My husband uses it though and says he likes it and his skin looks great!

The Philosophy Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser is an alright facial cleanser. It's good for use first thing in the morning and if you are not wearing makeup. Even after using makeup remover, this doesn't remove the remaining makeup. It doesn't leave the skin squeaky clean. It's almost like it leaves a residue on my skin. The pump is easy to dispense.

I'll be honest, I was a little concerned with how strong the scent would be since I'm not a big fan of scented face cleanser but I did enjoy the subtle scent this one had. The foam was different from what I am used to but was very nice to use. Easy to use and after washing off and drying. My face felt very soft and moisturized.
This beautifully simple cleanser foams up nicely, feels silky-soft on the skin, and leaves my face feeling fresh. It's an essential part of my shower routine.

My face feels actually clean after every wash — not tight, not stripped, just soft and balanced the way skin is supposed to feel. Gentle enough for sensitive skin, removes every trace of makeup, and my whole routine has leveled up just from starting with a better base. One thing worth mentioning - and you can see it in my pics - one pump gives you a LOT of product. Like, more than you'd expect. It's a foam so it expands, which means you'll definitely want to start with less than you think you need. It's not a dealbraker at all, just something to be aware of so you're not going through the bottle faster than necessary. o Still a five star cleanser for me though. The results speak for themselves.
I love the texture of a foam cleanser especially one that lathers up really nicely! Easy to dispense and leaves my skin feeling super clean without the tightness.

I've been using philosophy's Pore Purifying foam cleanser now for a couple weeks and I've noticed my skin is smoother and soo much more cleaner. It lathers good. It removes oil and dirt without leaving my skin dry or tight feeling. A little goes a long way.

I'm so impressed with this face cleanser! The infusion with papaya enzyme is a major bonus. These natural exfoliant gently helps to refine a skin texture and reduce the appearance of pores, given my skin a noticeable smoother more even look.

I was always a fan of the Purity cleanser but I must confess that this foam version is even better than the original! The packaging is sleek and elegant, the foam is easy to use and it cleasens without stripping my skin. I have very dry skin and I was worried it would cause some tightness but it didn't! It has the classic purity scent which I love! It's a great foam cleanser and one I look forward to using every night!

This foam cleanser has a pleasant fresh scent and a secure leak-proof pump. It lathers well, cleanses gently, and rinses off easily. My skin feels clean and refreshed without dryness, tightness, or irritation. It works well even on sensitive skin and leaves a comfortable feeling after use.

Love the consistency of this product. It's a foam but it's substantial enough to have a bit of a creamy texture so you can really rub it in the face. My face really feels clean afterwards too without feeling tight. I haven't noticed any redness after I'm through with washing my face so I think it would be good for sensitive skin. The one thing is that it has a scent so if you don't like that maybe this isn't for you?

I'd suggest tying a rubber band on the neck of this so you prevent too much foam from being released, you only need a little bit to be effective. This cleans well and removes makeup without irritation but my skin feels dry after using this so I rely more on snail mucin to help. I didn't witness marked improvement with my skin with over a month of consistent use so this only works as a decent cleanser for me.

This is my holy grail face wash! I'm so excited they released it in a foam version. It feels like the foam makes the product work quicker and more effectively at cleaning my skin. I can notice a difference in my skin, specifically my pores are congested when I do not use this product! Highly recommend to others as the perfect cleanser that doesn't leave you skin feeling tight and dry after!

I love this airy, light face wash! It's got a clean, bright scent, perfect for the morning. One pump is the perfect amount and it is so gentle on my skin. The perfect first step to my morning routine!

As a former purity-cleanser-obsessed individual, I would like to say, im glad they have this as a foam. I used to save up money to buy the big bottle from them, but after a while, I fell out of love with it. I am being reintroduced to this product as a mid-30s individual with much drier skin, so I try not to be biased about this product. One, I love the foam, and I usually double cleansed with an oil cleanser since I wear sunscreen every day. It did not strip off too much of my natural oil and still leaves my skin someone neutral -- not dry or oily. I use micellar water on a cotton pad after to get rid of any residue from makeup or dirt, none! So that checks off, non-drying and cleanse my face very well. There's nothing to complain about. It's simple, and it works.

This cleanser really leaves your skin feeling squeaky clean! I love the foam pump! One pump will wash your hole face. I did find that I needed to remove my mascara with something a lil stronger. My daughter who is acne prone really lives it
great cleanser for dry skin. it leavs my skin feeling clean , fresh, and smoothing without drying it out. i also noticed a healthy glow after using it
I feel like this product made my skin feel dry (I'm very sensitive). I like a much softer smoother feel to my skin. It did seem to cleanse well and it dispenses nicely.
This is a beautiful foamy texture. I love how it cleans the skin so well. It feels so clean and comfortable with no tightness at all. Very impressive.

This is one of my favorite facial cleansers. I love that it has a foam texture. It takes off my makeup and leaves my face super clean. It's really good if you have sensitive skin. This is definitely something I'll keep buying and using.

The philosophy pore purifying foam cleanser is great for a deep, double cleanse. It foams nicely and has great coverage. I feel like it gives a good, deep cleanse and really cleans sebum from my pores. It smells a little citrusy and clean. I do have to be careful with using this too frequently on my cheeks and with my retinol because it can cause burning/skin barrier irritation.
I love this foaming cleaser, it is fantastic for deep cleaning, it leave skin fresh and smooth, love the pump design! And the price is totally reasonable!
